notesEn.ARG: 2022: ARS 4.501 (price in force from 2022-07); 2023: ARS 27.11 (price in force from 2023-07); 2024: ARS 83.942 (price in force from 2024-07); 2025: ARS 104.488 (price in force from 2025-07) (ENRE (Argentina), EDENOR tariff tables; EDENOR (Buenos Aires) band R2 energy charge, excluding fixed charges and taxes; not a national average, not mapped)
notesEn.BRA: 2015–2025: annual average from EPE (Brazil), Statistical Yearbook of Electricity; regulated-market average tariff (revenue ÷ sales), excluding taxes (ICMS, PIS/COFINS)
notesEn.CAN: 2015: CAD 0.164 (price on 2015-04-01); 2016: CAD 0.2012 (price on 2016-04-01); 2017: CAD 0.1862 (price on 2017-04-01); 2018: CAD 0.1511 (price on 2018-04-01); 2019: CAD 0.1585 (price on 2019-04-01); 2020: CAD 0.1321 (price on 2020-04-01); 2021: CAD 0.1564 (price on 2021-04-01); 2022: CAD 0.1606 (price on 2022-04-01); 2023: CAD 0.1592 (price on 2023-04-01); 2024: CAD 0.1748 (price on 2024-04-01); 2025: CAD 0.179 (price on 2025-04-01) (Hydro-Québec, Comparison of Electricity Prices in Major North American Cities; Toronto, 1,000 kWh a month, including taxes, on 1 April; not a national average (cities differ widely), not mapped)

notesEn.GBR: 2008–2019: Eurostat price for households using 2,500–4,999 kWh a year (all taxes included, mean of the two half-years); 2020–2025: annual average from DESNZ, Quarterly Energy Prices table 5.6.2; households using 2,500–4,999 kWh a year (the Eurostat band), including taxes, mean of the two half-years
